mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the recovery lining was most worthwhile because the result connected the action to reabsorption and explained what continues along the tubule.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the filter and tubule was the least informative moment: it created a filtration route but gave no explanation until the following action.

surprise.text: The filter lets useful glucose leave the blood along with water, salts and urea; the distinction between filtrate and finished urine made that consequence clear.

arbitrary.text: None of the connections felt arbitrary, but each decision had only one offered combination, so I was following the menu rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more meaningful choices. The filtration and recovery explanations were useful, but this chapter gave me little to decide.
